_comment: Sparse operator override: explicit true leaves render override source/kind; untouched leaves stay unknown. Baseline Go rejects [capabilities] at startup, so this REDs fast via validate-config.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning]
supported = true

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".tools]
supported = true
name: m4_capability_override_true_explicit
